patterns.note: Sections frequently use a single, dominant background color (often a bold red or light neutral) that spans the full width of the viewport, creating distinct visual blocks.
Content within sections is typically centered and constrained, contrasting with the full-bleed background colors, and often features large, simple illustrations or typography.
A strong typographic contrast is used, pairing an elegant, classic serif typeface for the brand name and large display text with a clean, modern sans-serif for body copy and navigation.

The primary navigation bar at the top and a cookie consent banner at the bottom right remain sticky as the user scrolls, while content sections reveal themselves by scrolling vertically into the viewport.
Testimonial sections feature a horizontal carousel with navigation dots, presenting client feedback in a structured, digestible format.

technique_notes: To rebuild the motion system, implement a sticky header and a sticky cookie banner using CSS position: fixed. Content sections should scroll naturally into view, with no complex scroll-triggered animations observed beyond standard browser behavior, though smooth scrolling might be enhanced by a library like locomotive-scroll.
Achieve the distinct section styling by applying full-width background colors to parent containers, with inner content elements centered and given a max-width for readability.

Create typographic hierarchy by using a display serif font for prominent branding elements and headings, and a legible sans-serif for all other text, ensuring sufficient line height and letter spacing for readability.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful display headings (~3-4x body) with a classic serif character, contrasted with clean, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced, with generous vertical spacing between full-width sections and comfortable padding around content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold and confident use of a single, dominant red color across large, full-bleed sections, creating a strong brand presence. This is elegantly balanced by the sophisticated, classic serif typeface used for the brand name, giving it a unique blend of modern boldness and timeless authority.
